title: Coconut Rice & Beans with {v}
steps: Soften the {v} with the {spice} in a pot with a little oil.

Add the {s}, the {p}, the {sauce} and enough water to cover the rice by a knuckle. Dried red kidney beans need soaking, then a hard boil of at least 10 minutes, first; canned beans only need draining.
Bring to a boil, cover and simmer on low until the rice is tender, about 20 minutes. Check that any meat is at least 165°F / 74°C inside.
Fluff with a fork, rest 5 minutes covered, and finish with lime or fresh herbs.
tip: Use more beans than meat, add plenty of veg and finish with lime instead of extra salt.
